messages:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty triggered: high error rate (5xx, timeouts) on /v1/generate in us-west-1. Alert PD#4502. Escalating to eng-runtime oncall.

devon: ack — I'm on it, pulling logs. 5xx spike started ~3178001200 (approx). Any recent prod deploys?

maria: no deploys from prod in the last 30m. seeing repeated segfaults in model-runner logs. snippet: 
```
[2026-03-15T17:12:37Z] model-runner[pid=4231] SIGSEGV at 0x0
backtrace: libattention.so +0x1f4a, model_runner::kv_cache::read+0x9a, model_runner::forward+0x1cc
```

sachin: interesting — segfault inside attention kernel. could be a driver issue or a quantization kernel regression. any pattern by model id or seq len?

devon: yes, majority of failures for model=redwood-xl-qlora-v2 when sequence_len > 2048. also saw OOMs preceding some segfaults.

lisa: customer impact: top affected tenants: AcmeCorp (25% of errors), StudyBot (12%), FreeTrial buckets (40%). latency also spikes to 10-20s before returning 5xx.

ops-bot: Hot hosts: gpu-node-uw1-12 (78 failures), gpu-node-uw1-07 (41 failures) — sus.

jordan: quick mitigation plan: route traffic for redwood-xl-qlora-v2 to redwood-xl-qlora-v1 (compat) + enable soft-fallback to redwood-small if v1 saturates. disable the quant-path that touches the custom kernel.

devon: rolling a temporary routing rule now:
```
# route rule (temporary)
redwood.route.add({"model":"redwood-xl-qlora-v2","fallback":"redwood-xl-qlora-v1","weight":0})
```

devon: applied. verifying...

maria: also bumping eviction timeout and clearing KV cache on the two hot nodes:
```
ssh gpu-node-uw1-12 sudo systemctl restart model-runner && sudo rm -rf /var/modelcache/kv/*
ssh gpu-node-uw1-07 sudo systemctl restart model-runner && sudo rm -rf /var/modelcache/kv/*
```

sachin: note — restarting model-runner will drop in-flight requests; route change first is the right order.

devon: after route change error rate dropped from ~18% -> ~3% in 3m. still seeing isolated 5xx from uw1-12.

lisa: I'm opening a customer P1 for AcmeCorp and notifying account ops. updating status page.

ops-bot: Created INC-2026-4389 and added initial timeline.

maria: grabbing a memory map from failing process for later bisect:
```
/proc/4231/maps:
7f800000-7f9a0000 r-xp 00000000 00:12 123456 libattention.so
...
```

sachin: can we hot-config to skip the custom attention kernel and force reference kernel or AVX2 path? should avoid segfaults at cost of perf.

jordan: yes — runtime supports ATTENTION_KERNEL override. hot-config to affected nodes is safest.

devon: pushing hot-config to uw1-12 and uw1-07:
```
redwoodctl hot-config set --nodes=uw1-12,uw1-07 ATTENTION_KERNEL=ref
```

devon: applied. monitoring.

devon: error rate flattened ~1% now. latency up ~200ms for long sequences but stable.

lisa: customer update draft: "We've identified a runtime attention kernel regression causing crashes for long-context requests. We've rerouted traffic and applied a hot-config to avoid the kernel. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a postmortem." adding ETA EOD.

maria: add apology and mention impacted customers will get outreach.

devon: handing off to next oncall @alex in ~18m. need deeper debug: reproduce locally with long-seq workload and bisect commit that introduced quant kernel change.

alex: thanks — taking over. I'll coordinate a bisect and schedule kernel revert if we see regression in mainline. assigning to eng-runtime.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded. next-oncall: alex. Reminder: escalate to eng-sre if host-level instability continues.

lisa: closing PD page for now, will keep customers informed.

alex: taking this, will post updates in the incident doc. assigning postmortem owner @maria.
